summary: The Jacksonville Jaguars beat the New Orleans Saints 31-24 on Week 7 'Thursday Night Football' on Oct. 19, 2023, at the Caesars SuperDome. Jacksonville led 24-9 entering the fourth quarter, but New Orleans scored two late touchdowns to tie it before Christian Kirk's 44-yard touchdown reception with 3:08 left restored the lead. The Saints came up short on a final drive, and the note also includes pregame notes, viewing information and a drive-by-drive log.
one_line: Jaguars held off a late Saints comeback to win 31-24 on Thursday Night Football in Week 7, improving to 5-2.
key_facts: The Jaguars beat the Saints 31-24 on Week 7 'Thursday Night Football' on Oct. 19, 2023, improving to 5-2 and extending their winning streak to four games.
The Saints dropped to 3-4; the score by quarter was Jaguars 7, 10, 7, 7 and Saints 3, 3, 3, 15.
Jacksonville led 24-9 entering the fourth quarter after Foye Oluokun returned a Derek Carr deflected pass for a pick-six.
New Orleans scored two fourth-quarter touchdowns, including a Carr touchdown pass to Michael Thomas and a two-point conversion to Alvin Kamara, to tie it 24-24 with under six minutes left.
Christian Kirk took a short pass from Trevor Lawrence and ran 44 yards for a touchdown to retake the lead with 3:08 to go.
On the final drive, Foster Moreau dropped a would-be touchdown on third-and-goal, and Buster Brown broke up a fourth-down pass to Chris Olave with the Saints down seven.
Travis Etienne Jr. scored two rushing touchdowns, from two yards out and 17 yards out, and has found the end zone six times in his last three games.
Saints rookie kicker Blake Grupe missed a 51-yard field goal on the opening drive, then made kicks of 23, 35 and 42 yards.
Doug Pederson called a fake punt before halftime, Logan Cooke to Tim Jones for 17 yards, leading to a Brandon McManus field goal after a Marcus Lattimore interception was overturned.

Trevor Lawrence started after a pregame workout to test his knee; Jamaal Williams returned from injured reserve for the Saints, and Alvin Kamara was playing with him for the first time this season after his three-game suspension.
The Saints held a 5-2 all-time series lead over the Jaguars before the game; they last met in 2019, a 13-9 Saints win.
The game aired on Amazon Prime Video at 8:15 p.m. ET, with Al Michaels, Kirk Herbstreit and Kaylee Hartung; Amazon has an 11-year deal for the package.
